newsitem.title: UK: Pope in salmon firm's bad books over unpaid bills.
newsitem.headline: Pope in salmon firm's bad books over unpaid bills.

text.p: A small Scottish smoked salmon company has dropped Pope John Paul as a customer because it was fed up with being paid late, the Sunday Telegraph reported.
"Getting paid from the Vatican proved as much a miracle as feeding the 5,000," John Mackenzie, chairman of family firm Hebridean Seafoods, told the newspaper.

Until recently 200 kilos of salmon, worth about $4,000, was shipped to the Vatican every two weeks. The Pope was said to like the fish because it came from unpolluted waters in the Outer Hebrides off the west coast of Scotland.
